sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge the notice period in our framework agreement and have therefore adjusted the effective date to 1 February 2027.
We are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms at a unit price of €52.40.
We value our long-standing partnership and ask that you provide data to substantiate your claims regarding alternative sources.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €52.40 per unit.
Please send us the competing offer you mentioned.
Please send us the second-source quote you mentioned.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We have received your latest message, but without the requested data regarding alternative sources, we cannot consider further adjustments.
Our offer of €52.40 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains firm.
We value our long-standing partnership and trust we can conclude this negotiation constructively.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We note your latest offer, but you have again not provided the requested data regarding alternative sources.
Without this proof, we cannot consider further adjustments and must hold our offer at €52.40.
Please send us the competing offer you mentioned so we can review it.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have already taken that notice period data into account. We have stated our final offer, yet you continue to lower your proposed price while repeating claims that are not backed by the data you provided. As we have not received the requested proof regarding alternative sources, we see no basis for further discussion. We must therefore withdraw from this negotiation, though we remain open to fair and fact-based discussions in the future. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
